targets.intent: Find the navigation link that takes you to your personal account profile

targets.intent: Find the button that launches the open-enrolment wizard for selecting employee benefits
targets.expected_stable_signal: button with data-testid='enroll-benefits-btn' and aria-label='Start benefits enrolment'; Angular _ngcontent-hr-c20 is volatile

targets.intent: Find the decorative card that displays the total hours worked this month
targets.expected_stable_signal: NONE — div with class PayslipCard--r3s4t5 only; no aria-label, no data-testid, no stable id; failure classification: observation_lacked_stable_signal

targets.intent: Find the toggle switch that enables or disables direct deposit for your salary payments
